name: The Newsletter Plugin
line: Self-hosted WordPress newsletters, campaigns and email sequences.

free.text: Free plugin; no subscriber cap; server and sending costs extra

cells.newsletters: Yes, with opt-in controls and unsubscribe links
cells.api: Yes, free REST for Newsletter; no general app-mail relay

subs.math: 1,000 subscribers × 4 campaigns. Each email is 32 KB. $12 server + $0.64 Amazon SES + $0.01536 data. Amazon SES approval is required; tax, domain and backups are extra. Journeys need the $140 one-time Pro plan.

5,000 subscribers × 4 campaigns. Each email is 32 KB. $12 server + $3.20 Amazon SES + $0.0768 data. Amazon SES approval is required; tax, domain and backups are extra. Journeys need the $140 one-time Pro plan.

10,000 subscribers × 4 campaigns. Each email is 32 KB. $12 server + $6.40 Amazon SES + $0.1536 data. Amazon SES approval is required; tax, domain and backups are extra. Journeys need the $140 one-time Pro plan.

50,000 subscribers × 4 campaigns. Each email is 32 KB. $12 server + $32 Amazon SES + $0.768 data. Amazon SES approval is required; tax, domain and backups are extra. Journeys need the $140 one-time Pro plan.
